means: The brow drawn down and pulled together - the single line of ink that carries anger, strain and concentration in anime faces.
does: Creases the forehead and tilts the inner eyebrow down, which hardens an otherwise neutral face more efficiently than any other single tag. It is the difference between a character who is looking and a character who is deciding. The limit is physical: the brow is a few dozen pixels outside close framing, so on a medium or wide shot this costs you a tag slot and changes nothing you can see. Face tags and shot size are one decision, not two.
reach_for_it: close-ups of anger, effort or concentration - and only close-ups
used_in: the eyes field of emotions/angry and determined, the face field of focus and panic; visible in every compiled 'determined expression, serious, sharp eyes, furrowed brow' beat of derby-ep1.json
